shared_elements: figural imagery (schematic anthropomorphic/creature forms in A; human figures in B)
justification: Both surfaces bear carved figural imagery in relief, but the specific content is unrelated: A shows large curvilinear schematic motifs (spirals, an eye/face-like mask form, blob-like bodies) crowded onto an irregular boulder with no register structure, while B shows a procession of naturalistically proportioned standing human figures in profile with garments, headgear and a led animal, ordered into stacked horizontal registers separated by plain bands and stylized trees. Beyond the trivial fact of carved figures on stone, there is no shared motif, relationship or compositional scheme.
